main-start-description:
Dear pioneer!
   You are on the verge of wondrous discoveries.
   The doors of the most wonderful place in the world – our favorite Camp Sovionok – have opened before you! You'll remember this session for the rest of your life.
   Welcome!
main-load-description:
Treat the history of our camp with care. Thoroughly write down all your observations and thoughts of the days past.
   Using the savings you will always be able to come back to the the already completed episode and interpret it again.
   Good luck with all your undertakings!
main-gallery-description:
And this is our photography club. Your comrades are always ready to capture the most important moments of the camp's life, and you can even see yourself on many of the photographs.
   Keep yourself tidy and be a role model for those around you.
